english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for a taxi.
This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a taxi or cab.

examples.english: We called a taxi to the airport.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 giu3 zo2 dik1 si2 heoi3 gei1 coeng4

examples.english: We called a cab to the airport.
examples.traditional: 我哋叫咗部的士去機場。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 giu3 zo2 bou6 dik1 si2 heoi3 gei1 coeng4
